frames.name: thinkingA
frames.prompt: Edit the reference SofIA into ONE full-resolution transparent PNG pose for a thinking animation. Keep exact same portrait canvas 937x1678 or higher, identical character size, body position, camera, feet baseline and full-body framing. Preserve exact silver segmented robot face, crisp cyan blue visor, orbital halo, blue eyes, dark cable neck, pink collared ElasGPS polo with legible logo, dark indigo jeans, silver robot hands/arms and complete silver boots. Native sharp details at least as sharp as reference, no blur, no soft rendering. ONLY pose change: BOTH ARMS CROSSED naturally and anatomically correctly across her upper torso/chest, relaxed shoulders, each hand rests on the opposite upper arm. No hand near the mouth or chin, no finger touching face. Calm thoughtful professional expression, closed mouth, gaze slightly upward as if considering a question. REMOVE the floating holographic head completely, as neither hand is holding it in this crossed-arms pose; KEEP the cyan orbital ring around her head. No thought bubble or text drawn into the PNG; UI will provide that separately. ONE woman only, all limbs and boots uncropped, exact identity and pink/blue/silver palette. Completely transparent RGBA background alpha 0 outside the character and between limbs, no ground/floor/shadow plane, no colored matte, no grid, no checkerboard. Never create a sprite sheet.

frames.name: respondingA
frames.prompt: Create ONE single full-resolution transparent RGBA portrait animation keyframe of this EXACT SofIA reference character. One character only, never a grid, atlas, collage or multiple copies. Full body INCLUDING both complete boots, all limbs, orbital halo and hologram visible, uncropped, transparent margin around all extremities. Use maximum available portrait resolution, at least 1024x1536, same tall framing as the reference. Crucially match reference identity and sharp detailed rendering: exact silver blue segmented robot face, blue visor, bright cyan orbital ring, silver cable neck/arms/hands, pink collared ElasGPS polo with legible logo, dark jeans, silver boots. Preserve reference body proportions, head size, camera viewpoint, lighting, material sharpness and facial likeness. Fine fabric weave and mechanical edges must be tack sharp, no softness, blur, haze or painterly smoothing. Camera locked, character standing straight at exact same position with boot soles at 92% of image height and top of head/halo at 10%, character torso centered at 48% of image width. Cyan hologram remains above her raised left palm (viewer right). Output genuine alpha 0 background all around and between limbs. No background color, floor, contact shadow rectangle, grid, checkerboard or environment. Only pose change requested: her right hand makes a small open-palm explanatory gesture at waist/chest height, while left palm still holds cyan hologram. A gentle friendly smile with mouth slightly open as if explaining something, looking toward viewer. Feet and body stay in reference positions. This is a professional analyst speaking naturally, not an exaggerated wave.

frames.name: respondingB
frames.prompt: EDIT this image into ONE next animation keyframe, preserving the exact SAME full high-resolution canvas, single full body, face identity, sharp material details, crisp fine fabric texture and legible ElasGPS logo. Full body and both silver boots, dark jeans, pink polo, blue visor and orbital halo identical. Do not zoom, crop, reframe, change scale or camera. Preserve all transparent pixels and produce real RGBA transparency with alpha 0 outside the subject, including between limbs. No background, grid, floor, shadow plane, haze, color matte or duplicate characters. Keep entire body perfectly registered to the input. Make ONLY this very small pose change: Minimal animation continuation: gently rotate the open right palm by a few degrees inward, shift fingertips a tiny amount, and let the smile soften with lips almost closed. No change to feet, hips, shoulders, head size, camera, clothing, left hand or hologram position.
